description: Powerly helps small and medium-sized businesses build their own branded EV charging apps. Businesses can customize their branding, select app features, preview the configuration, and generate an app connected to Powerly’s EV charging platform. Generated apps can connect to compatible charging infrastructure and roaming networks using OCPP and OCPI.
